_description: The model version identifier (IP-unified-architecture §10). MAJOR = structural change (a law, a divisor set, H). MINOR = refit (coefficients move, structure does not). Deliberately OUTSIDE model-parameters.json: a version label must not change the model's content identity (CONSTANTS_HASH). Seeded at v10.0 continuing the repo's existing v9/v10 tag lineage (owner decision); MAJOR/MINOR bumps proceed from here under this scheme. Content identity is carried separately by CONSTANTS_HASH (model parameters) and COEFFICIENTS_HASH (the fit) in packages/physics/src/constants/.
_v14Note: v13.0 → v14.0 (2026-09, plan 06 Phases 1–2 + D7): a structural MAJOR. (1) The climate formula's L1 is no longer a divisor set: 25 lines derived from the engine's own Earth z/ζ modes and p (relative amplitude ≥ 0.1) plus the g₂−g₅ fundamental and its two climate-internal harmonics, one home (data/l1-physical-lines.json); the 33-integer comb and the L2 layer retire (T1). (2) A new term family: α(t) is the LAGGED viscoelastic response of the polar moment to that ice history, α = α₀ − k·[L1 − ⟨L1⟩_τ], k derived at runtime from the Cox–Chao rate, τ = 6 kyr MEASURED by the historical ΔT record (D7) — the instantaneous α ∝ L1 law and its stored scale retire. (3) The Core-mantle swing ships as the two-impulse episode only; its drive tone retires at amplitude 0. (4) The ΔT stack refit and the whole historical gate suite re-baselined (lunar 1213 s / 119 of 267, solar 665 s / 43 of 89); the ΔT-stack lattice labels measured at chance level (T5) and stated in years. The tidal chain, the planet chains, the Moon chain and the cardinal clock are unchanged.
_v13Note: v12.0 → v13.0: the model restatement (two engines + two expansions). A claims-layer MAJOR: the 8H lattice retires as planetary-orbit dynamics (typed descriptors remain — doc 109 §9); the Fibonacci structural claims retire (exact balance, the Saturn e-prediction, Config-#7 uniqueness, the node integers — doc 10 Status; the ~98% observation survives); Law 6 restated as the Earth-frame beat identity at J2000; the falsification criterion replaced by the three-legger (CLAUDE.md §Verification); ESSRT restated as the two-tier expansion (doc 99). The physics numbers are unchanged — every Earth-family gate bit-identical (browser tier 157/157).
_v11Note: v10.0 → v11.0 (2026-08): the Driver 1½ regime-aware lunar recession history — a new term family (the staircase spline beyond 1000 Ma + the two solar angular-momentum channels: ocean leak and thermal-tide pump). The gated 0–1000 Ma era is bit-identical to v10.0.
_v12Note: v11.0 → v12.0 (2026-08): the eccentricity unification — ONE eccentricity law for Sun, Moon, cardinal points and scene, e(t) = base′·(1 + cos θ₃/2) on the System-Reset anchor (a core-law change: the H/16 eccentricity law and the two-arm scene geometry are gone; H/16 is the perihelion-direction period only). Earth measured from the scene origin (wobble circle radius 0, the wobble-centre a display marker at the Law-4 A distance); Earth-frame refit 6b–6d + 5c + the ΔT joint re-close (USNO optimum 86400.0018); the declared measured-day basis (measuredMeanSolarDayJ2000Seconds).
